page_title: LEN 3-1 REN | Lens v Rennes 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Jeremie Pignard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
90+1' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' A dangerous looking corner kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
89' Here is a change. Mamadou Sangare is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Florian Sotoca (Lens).
88' Malang Sarr (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' Breel Embolo (Rennes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
78' It's time for a substitution. Amadou Haidara (Lens) comes on in place of Florian Thauvin.

78' 3 - 1 Goal! Allan Saint-Maximin (Lens) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box into the middle of the net, leaving Mathys Silistrie beaten. The score is 3:1.
78' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
75' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
73' Florian Thauvin (Lens) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
73' The resulting corner from Adrien Thomasson (Lens) comes to nothing.

72' Florian Thauvin (Lens) outmuscles the defender near the penalty spot and get his head to a cross from Allan Saint-Maximin. The accuracy is lacking, however, and the ball spins well wide of the right post.
70' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
69' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) is being substituted because of an injury. Habib Beye sends Mahamadou Nagida on the pitch.
67' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
67' The game is interrupted as Florian Thauvin (Lens) is flagged offside.
64' Habib Beye has decided to substitute Arnaud Nordin and he is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Rouault leaves the pitch and Lilian Brassier (Rennes) comes on.
64' Habib Beye has decided to make a change. Quentin Merlin (Rennes) replaces Sebastian Szymanski.
61' Arnaud Nordin (Rennes) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Allan Saint-Maximin (Lens) for Wesley Said.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) will replace Odsonne Edouard.
60' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kyllian Antonio (Lens) replacing Samson Baidoo.
58' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
56' RED CARD! Ruben Aguilar (Lens) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Jeremie Pignard. He can have an early bath.
54' 2 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Florian Thauvin is pounced on by Ruben Aguilar (Lens). His close-range header flashes past Mathys Silistrie and into the right of the goal. 2:1.
53' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
50' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
47' The linesman signals that Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Breel Embolo (Rennes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
41' 1 - 1 Odsonne Edouard (Lens) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
40' The game is interrupted now, Breel Embolo (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
35' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Adrien Thomasson (Lens), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
35' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) commits a rough foul. Jeremie Pignard stops the game and makes a call.
32' What was Ruben Aguilar (Lens) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
30' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
29' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal is substituted due to injury. Habib Beye gives a chance to Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
28' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Arnaud Nordin (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
25' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
24' The free kick from Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
23' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
20' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
19' Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Anthony Rouault (Rennes).
18' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremie Pignard signals.
16' The foul by Matthieu Udol (Lens) was seen by Jeremie Pignard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
12' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
8' 0 - 1 Arnaud Nordin feeds the ball through to Esteban Lepaul (Rennes), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
6' Wesley Said (Lens) has a goal ruled out for offside!
5' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
4' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
2' Florian Thauvin (Lens) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lens will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard will referee today's match.
